title: Allah (SWT)
intro: Allah is the Almighty Creator of everything that exists.

items: Allah is the Almighty Creator of everything that exists.
Allah is the One and Only God and the Lord of people.
Allah created us and gave us life and health.
Allah gives children a happy, joyful childhood.

learn.html:
He gave us a soul
from His own ruh,
and He gave us life –
the Eternal Creator.

Only Him I praise,
to sajdah I fall,
I hope for His reward
and His mercy.
(English translation)
learn.bs:
Podari nam dušu
On od ruha svog,
i život nam dade
Stvoritelj vječni.

Samo Njega slavim
i na sedždu padam,
nagradi se Njegovoj
i milosti nadam.

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: When we say Allah’s name, we add jalla jalaaluhu – in short (SWT) – which means the Most High.

practice.title: What has Allah given us?
practice.prompt: Tap everything Allah has given us, then tap Check.

questions.q: What do we add when we say Allah’s name?

practice.title: Questions to talk about
prompts: 💬 Who is our Lord? What did Allah create?
🎵 Learn the song about Allah, the Most High.
🎁 Think of something Allah, the Most High, has given us!
